limits: Illustrative handbook schedule, not a validated field maintenance procedure.
Durations and crew codes are printed. Start offsets are chart readings to 0.1 h, not mandated precedence or guaranteed precision.
Crew code is a source identifier; no staffing count or skill qualification inferred. Workload sum is task-hours, not a staffing recommendation.
Clean FOOD strainer preserves the printed wording; no silent correction to FEED.
Quantities use DurationValue and SI hour. Start is an offset from the source chart origin, not an absolute timestamp.
Allocation links preserve task-to-crew assignment. No cross-crew precedence, optimization, scheduling execution or safety approval claimed.
Schedule is an introduced view context. Its perform-action references expose TimedTask usages for allocation; the context does not assert that an organization performs every task.
